title: RosmarOps — Kit file
description: The rosmarops-kit file (CTO-10 §3): the kit key and the user salt, each wrapped with PBKDF2-SHA256 and AES-256-GCM, once under the secret phrase and once under the recovery code. Holds no key, salt, phrase or code in the clear.

envelopes.description: The phrase envelope, then the recovery_code envelope.

salt.description: 16 random bytes, standard base64, new for each envelope.

nonce.description: 12 random bytes, standard base64, new for each envelope.

ciphertext.description: AES-256-GCM of 1 version byte, the 32-byte key and the 32-byte user salt, with the GCM tag; standard base64. AAD: format|version|kit_id|key_id|type|kdf|iterations.
